label: PF Backlog 703
title: Memory Compiler: persona-specific retrieval profiles (Coding, QA, Security), relevance ranking, and context injection
body:
## Problem / why
All agents receive generic memory injections, resulting in irrelevant context, noisy prompts, and missed role-specific constraints.

## Goal & value
Implement the Memory Compiler to assemble persona-specific memory contexts (Coding, QA, Security) under strict token budget constraints.

## Reference Documents
- `docs/Product_Forge_Agent_Memory_Architecture_Integration.md#section-8`
- `docs/Product_Forge_Agent_Memory_Architecture_Integration.md#section-15`

## In scope
- Persona-specific retrieval policies (weights per memory kind, similarity thresholds, recency decay).
- Context assembly pipeline producing auditable prompt snippets.
- Relevance filtering suppressing noise and outdated execution traces.

## Out of scope
- Unbounded memory injection without token limits.

## Definition of Done
- Compiler tests verify distinct, role-tailored memory snippets for each agent persona.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
